trailhead.label: San Martino di Castrozza, the APT’s start

cautions: Village streets and road crossings in San Martino at the start and end.
Gravel forest road, shared with forestry vehicles.
A forest path up the side of the valley.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
